calculation.description: Negative trailing five-day asset return, scaled by the contemporaneous five-day DXY move. DXY is observation-only and is never traded; all prices are lagged so the signal is available before the forward return.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in pre-2024 (0.063088), 2024 onward (0.045013), and 2026 onward (0.041196). Small 15-instrument universe; uncertainty interpreted conservatively. The signal is almost collinear with unconditioned five-day reversal, so deterministic library audit may quarantine it for redundancy.
